video.title: Heart Meds, Running, and Feeling Like Myself Again
video.description:
A personal health-and-training edit: the dashboard showing BJJ, running, and lifting coming back, the post-hospitalization heart-rate ceiling, heart-medication changes, and the feeling of finally being able to push again.

Edit note: Pulls the health dashboard context together with the later heart-medication story so it works as one fitness-tech segment.

This is a topic-edited cut from the livestream: https://youtube.com/live/1liD1s8HlsQ?feature=share

Original livestream timestamp range(s): 36:38-38:32, 38:47-41:38, 52:12-59:17

Not medical, legal, financial, or training advice. Personal experience and commentary.
